# SRD 5.2.1 data (2024 rules) — generated, do not edit by hand

Regenerate with `npm run data:srd52` (source pinned in `scripts/srd52/source.json`, hand additions in
`scripts/srd52/supplement/`). The texts in `locales/en/srd52/` are generated with it; the other languages come
from the official translations (see `docs/TRANSLATING.md`).

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 ("SRD 5.2.1") by Wizards of the Coast
LLC and available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. The SRD 5.2.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution
4.0 International License available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.

The structured data is derived from a fork of [5e-bits/5e-srd-api](https://github.com/5e-bits/5e-srd-api)
(`Mystikal91/5e-srd-api`, branch `integration`; MIT License of the 5e-database project).

`scripts/srd52/supplement/mounts-and-vehicles.json` holds what that source lacks and the book has: mounts and other
animals, drawn vehicles, saddles, feed and the waterborne and air vehicles. The names, prices and weights come from
the SRD 5.2 data of [open5e](https://github.com/open5e/open5e-api) and were each checked against the tables of the
SRD 5.2.1 (kilograms to pounds); the carrying capacities and the columns of the table of ships come from the
book's tables. They carry no description, because the book has none for them.
